details.jobDescription:
As a Financial Accountant you will support the company's financial operations by managing end-to-end finance including invoices processing, payments execution and account receivables activities, while ensuring accurate financial records in SAP.
Key Responsibilities︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉
• Posting incoming invoices using FB60/F-43 (non-PO) in accordance with predefined instructions;
• Posting purchase order-related incoming invoices using MIRO in accordance with predefined instructions;
• Preparing outgoing payments;
• Importing bank statements;
• Recording and posting incoming payments;
• Managing accounts receivable, including dunning and credit management;
• Supporting month-end closing activities;
• Providing support in SAP projects;
• Providing SAP Concur support (administration).

Your profile
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, or comparable qualification, or professional experience in an accounting environment;
• Good knowledge of SAP;
• Very good written and spoken English skills; any other foreign language is a plus;
• Confident user of Microsoft 365, especially Excel.

What we offer
• Professional development: you will be part of an international team committed to support you to learn new skills and shape a carreer path that fits you, with access to various learning platforms;
• Onboarding & Integration: we ensure a smooth and efficient integration through a structured onboarding program, complemented by the ongoing support of a collaborative team;
• We prioritize your well-being: therefore we’re granting access to high-quality healthcare services through our comprehensive private medical insurance;
• Gifts for Special Occasions: Easter Holidays, Winter Holidays, 8th of March for our ladies colleagues;
• Flexibility: we support a healthy work-life balance by offering flexible arrangements tailored to your role and responsibilities;
• Bonuses: performance bonuses as a reward of your achievements and referral bonuses as a thank you for helping our team growth.

Meet us here: https://www.weidmueller.ro/ro/index.jsp

Weidmüller – our name has been synonymous with power, competence and reliability in machine construction, the process industry, device manufacture, the energy sector and traffic engineering for more than 160 years. In more than 80 countries, we support both our customers and our partners by supplying innovative solutions and services, as well as cutting a convincing figure as a partner that you can depend on.
